title: Strapworks Heavyweight Polypropylene Webbing, 2 in x 25 yd, Khaki

comparisons.notes: Manufacturer's own page for 2 Inch Heavyweight Polypropylene Khaki (WSR-PRO-HWP-002-KAK), in stock; 75 ft roll option $27.81, same 25 yd length and specs (1,800 lb break strength, 0.06 in thick). Shipping not included.

writeup: A full 25-yard roll of Strapworks 2-inch heavyweight polypropylene webbing in khaki, new, for $6.99. Strapworks' own site charges $27.81 for the same 75-foot roll. It's rated at 1,800 lb break strength and 0.06 in thick, handy for gear repair, tie-downs and DIY straps.
